disk-snapshot-full-on-premium-costlier.title: Incremental snapshots are stored on cheaper Standard HDD
disk-snapshot-full-on-premium-costlier.body: This estimate uses full snapshots of a Premium SSD or Standard SSD disk, which are stored on SSD storage at a higher per-GB rate. Microsoft states incremental snapshots use Standard HDD storage whatever the source disk type; use incremental unless a full copy is required.

citation.quote: Incremental snapshots use Standard HDD storage, regardless of the source disk's storage type, whereas full snapshots can use Premium SSD storage.
